overclaims: This earlier, narrower snapshot neither verifies nor contradicts the claimed April 1–21, 2026 figures: 114GW scheduled through end-2028, with 15.2GW under construction, including 5GW scheduled for 2026 [e1].
checks.note: The proposition drops two things: that Sightline told him the figures, and the 5GW-due-in-2026 part. It also widens the scope to all 'AI data center capacity', but the contract limits it to Sightline's tracked projects (>50MW, not only AI). The rationale calls the figures 'April 1–21, 2026', but that date range is the contract's reading; the statement gives no date. Its [e1] tag also sits on the speaker's own figures, which e1 does not contain. Outcome, axis and horizon match the reviews. The e1 excerpt is very short but accurate.
